# BlockHelm Launcher 26A17093 Beta

- Made foreground glass visibly deeper with stronger real-time pointer refraction, caustics, and edge light.
- Unified the liquid-glass treatment across search fields, inputs, navigation, content surfaces, dialogs, secondary panels, dropdowns, and launcher logs.
- Preserved the existing highly transparent Gaussian-blur launcher background and all launcher functionality.
- Improved press feedback and light/dark theme contrast while keeping glass transparent.
